title: 第十二章 天机阁主第十三章 归途
content_zh:
地下空间中的气氛凝固到了极点。
楚云天悬浮在半空中，手中的幽蓝色光球还在凝聚，但已经停止了继续扩大的趋势。他的目光死死盯着突然出现的白衣人，眼神中充满了警惕和忌惮。
天机阁主站在方圆身前，衣袂无风自动，腰间的长剑虽然未出鞘，但剑意已经弥漫开来，像一层无形的屏障，将楚云天的灵压挡在外面。
方圆站在他身后，指尖的金色光芒悄然散去。
蓄力被打断了，但他的本源之力没有消耗掉——这意味着他不需要付出修为跌落的代价。
王紫璇从地上爬起来，膝盖还在发抖，但她咬着牙站稳了。她的眼睛盯着天机阁主的背影，心中翻涌着无数疑问。
天机阁主。这个在整个天玄大陆都如雷贯耳的名字，她从小就在各种传闻中听说过。
据说天机阁主无所不知，天下没有他查不到的秘密。
据说天机阁主的修为深不可测，有人猜测他至少是元婴境巅峰，也有人猜测他早已突破到了化神境。
但从来没有人见过他出手，也从来没有人知道他的真面目。
现在，他就站在她面前。
白衣，黑发，面容看起来不到三十岁，但那双眼睛里的深邃和沧桑，像是经历了千百年岁月洗礼的古井，平静得让人心慌。
“天机阁主。”楚云天冷冷开口，“你不在中州待着，跑到这穷乡僻壤来做什么？”
天机阁主微微一笑：“楚长老来做什么，在下就来做什么。”
“你也想要万劫魔石？”楚云天的眼睛眯了起来，“天机阁向来中立，不参与任何势力的争斗。你若是来抢魔石的，那就是在打破天机阁万年来的规矩。”
“规矩是死的，人是活的。”天机阁主的声音不急不缓，“况且，在下不是来抢魔石的。在下是来阻止你的。”
“阻止我？”楚云天冷笑一声，“你以为你阻止得了？”
“试试看。”
三个字，轻描淡写，却带着一种不容置疑的笃定。
楚云天的脸色变了变。

如果换做别人说这句话，他早就一掌拍过去了。元婴境五重的修为，在整个天玄大陆都算得上顶尖高手，能让他忌惮的人不多。
但天机阁主恰恰是其中之一。
不是因为天机阁主的修为一定比他高——他从来没有跟天机阁主交过手，不知道对方的深浅。他忌惮的是天机阁背后的东西。
天机阁存在了上万年，经历过无数朝代更迭、宗门兴衰，却始终屹立不倒。每一任阁主都神秘莫测，没有人知道他们的来历，也没有人知道他们的底牌。
曾经有一个化神境的老祖想要强行闯入天机阁盗取情报，第二天那位老祖的头颅就被挂在了自家宗门的牌匾上。
从那以后，再也没有人敢对天机阁动手。
“你知道这块魔石是谁要的吗？”楚云天压低了声音，语气中带着威胁。
“中州楚家。”天机阁主说，“不，准确地说，不是楚家，而是楚家背后的那个人。”
楚云天的瞳孔猛地一缩。
“你怎么知道——”
“天机阁无所不知。”天机阁主打断了他，“楚长老，在下劝你一句：那块魔石你不能带走。不是在下要拦你，而是那块魔石已经被污染了。”
“被污染了？”楚云天低头看向掌心的万劫魔石。
黑色的石头表面，裂纹比刚才更多了。细密的裂纹从顶部延伸到根部，像一张蜘蛛网覆盖在魔石表面。从裂纹中渗出的黑色雾气越来越多，发出嘶嘶的声响，像是什么东西在腐烂。
楚云天的脸色变得很难看。
“这是怎么回事？”他猛地抬头看向方圆，“你做了什么？”
方圆从天机阁主身后走出来，与楚云天对视。
“你的法阵是用活人献祭来喂养魔石，对吧？”方圆的声音很平静，“但你忽略了一件事——那些被你当作祭品的人，他们在死前的怨念和恐惧，也被魔石吸收了。”
楚云天皱眉：“那又如何？魔石本来就是以负面情绪为食，怨念和恐惧正是它需要的养分。”
“正常情况下是这样。”方圆说，“但你的法阵太粗糙了。你只想着让魔石吸收祭品的力量，却没有过滤祭品死前的意识碎片。十四个人的怨念、恐惧、不甘、仇恨，全部混在一起，在魔石内部发酵了十五年。”
他顿了顿，一字一句地说：“那块魔石，已经‘疯’了。”

楚云天脸色大变。
他再次低头看向掌心的魔石，这一次，他看得更仔细了。
content_en:
The atmosphere in the underground space was frozen to the extreme.
Chu Yuntian was suspended in mid-air, and the blue ball of light in his hand was still condensing, but it had stopped expanding. His eyes were fixed on the man in white who suddenly appeared, his eyes full of vigilance and fear.
The master of Tianji Pavilion stood in front of Fangyuan, his clothes were still in the wind. Although the long sword at his waist was not unsheathed, the sword's intention was already diffused, like an invisible barrier, blocking Chu Yuntian's spiritual pressure.
Fangyuan stood behind him, the golden light on her fingertips quietly dissipated.
The charge was interrupted, but his original power was not consumed - which meant that he did not need to pay the price of falling cultivation.
Wang Zixuan got up from the ground, her knees were still shaking, but she gritted her teeth and stood firm. Her eyes were fixed on the back of the Master of Tianji Pavilion, and countless questions were surging in her heart.
The master of Tianji Pavilion. She had heard this name in various rumors since she was a child, which was very popular throughout the Tianxuan Continent.
It is said that the Master of Tianji Pavilion knows everything and there is no secret in the world that he cannot find.
It is said that the cultivation level of the Master of Tianji Pavilion is unfathomable. Some people speculate that he is at least at the peak of Nascent Soul Realm, while others speculate that he has already broken through to the Divine Transformation Realm.
But no one has ever seen him take action, and no one has ever known his true identity.
Now, he was standing in front of her.
White clothes, black hair, and a face that looks less than thirty years old, but the depth and vicissitudes in those eyes are like ancient wells that have experienced thousands of years of baptism, so calm that it makes people panic.
"Master Tianji Pavilion." Chu Yuntian said coldly, "If you don't stay in Zhongzhou, what are you doing here in this remote place?"
The Master of Tianji Pavilion smiled slightly: "I will do whatever Elder Chu comes to do."
"You also want the Demonic Stone of Ten Thousand Tribulations?" Chu Yuntian's eyes narrowed, "Tianji Pavilion has always been neutral and does not participate in the battles between any forces. If you come to snatch the magic stone, you are breaking the rules of Tianji Pavilion for thousands of years."
"Rules are dead, people are alive." The voice of the Master of Tianji Pavilion was unhurried, "Besides, I'm not here to steal the magic stone. I'm here to stop you."
"Stop me?" Chu Yuntian sneered, "Do you think you can stop me?"
"Try it."
Three words, an understatement, but with an unquestionable certainty.
Chu Yuntian's expression changed.
If someone else had said this, he would have slapped him away. With cultivation at the fifth level of the Nascent Soul Realm, he is considered a top expert in the entire Tianxuan Continent, and there are not many people he can fear.
But the master of Tianji Pavilion is exactly one of them.
It's not because the master of the Tianji Pavilion must be higher in cultivation than him - he has never fought against the master of the Tianji Pavilion and doesn't know how good the opponent is. What he was afraid of was what was behind Tianji Pavilion.
Tianji Pavilion has existed for tens of thousands of years, and has experienced countless changes in dynasties and the rise and fall of sects, but it has always stood firm. Every Pavilion Master is mysterious, no one knows their origins, and no one knows their trump cards.
There was once an ancestor who was in the realm of gods and wanted to force his way into Tianji Pavilion to steal information. The next day, the ancestor's head was hung on the plaque of his sect.
From then on, no one dared to attack Tianji Pavilion.
"Do you know who wants this magic stone?" Chu Yuntian lowered his voice with a threat in his tone.
"Zhongzhou Chu Family." The Master of Tianji Pavilion said, "No, to be precise, it's not the Chu Family, but the person behind the Chu Family."
Chu Yuntian's pupils shrank suddenly.
"How do you know-"
"Tianji Pavilion knows everything." The master of Tianji Pavilion interrupted him, "Elder Chu, I would like to advise you: you can't take away that magic stone. It's not that I want to stop you, but that magic stone has been contaminated."
"Contaminated?" Chu Yuntian lowered his head and looked at the Demonic Stone in his palm.
The surface of the black stone has more cracks than before. Fine cracks extend from the top to the roots, covering the surface of the magic stone like a spider web. fromMore and more black mist seeped out of the cracks, making a hissing sound, like something was rotting.
Chu Yuntian's face turned ugly.
"What's going on?" He suddenly looked up at Fang Yuan, "What did you do?"
Fangyuan walked out from behind the master of Tianji Pavilion and looked at Chu Yuntian.
"Your magic circle uses human sacrifices to feed the magic stone, right?" Fang Yuan's voice was very calm, "But you ignored one thing - the resentment and fear of those who were sacrificed by you before they died were also absorbed by the magic stone."
Chu Yuntian frowned: "So what? The magic stone feeds on negative emotions. Resentment and fear are the nutrients it needs."
"That's the case under normal circumstances." Fang Yuan said, "But your magic circle is too rough. You only wanted to let the magic stone absorb the power of the sacrifice, but you did not filter out the fragments of consciousness of the sacrifice before death. The resentment, fear, unwillingness, and hatred of the fourteen people were all mixed together and fermented inside the magic stone for fifteen years."
He paused and said word by word: "That magic stone has gone crazy."
Chu Yuntian's expression changed drastically.
He looked down at the magic stone in his palm again, this time, he looked more carefully.
